lines.zh: 我每走一步，脚下的石头就发红。
lines.en: Each step I take leaves the stone glowing red.

lines.zh: 沉重的身体碾过地面，裂缝跟着我。
lines.en: My heavy body grinds forward and cracks follow me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为我不必追。
lines.en: I walk slowly, because I never need to chase.

lines.zh: 热气把我前面的草都烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat curls the grass ahead of me.

lines.zh: 石板被我的脚印烧出焦痕。
lines.en: My footprints burn scorch marks into the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，灰从我肩上落下。
lines.en: I drag my steps and ash falls from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 祭坛的台阶挡不住我，我踩平它。
lines.en: The altar steps cannot stop me; I flatten them.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪化成水再化成汽。
lines.en: Where I pass, snow becomes water, then steam.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪，方向只由我定。
lines.en: I shift step by step; only I choose the direction.

lines.zh: 这具身体太重，地面替我记住每一步。
lines.en: This body is heavy; the ground remembers every step.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，周围的空气在抖。
lines.en: I stand still and the air around me shivers.

lines.zh: 火从我背脊的缝里慢慢冒。
lines.en: Fire seeps slowly from the seams of my back.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，里面像有炉子。
lines.en: I look at my hands; a furnace seems to burn inside.

lines.zh: 远处的鸟不叫了，我很满意。
lines.en: The distant birds have gone silent; I am pleased.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，火从不熄。
lines.en: I have waited long, and the fire never goes out.

lines.zh: 一块玉在我胸口发烫。
lines.en: A piece of jade burns hot in my chest.

lines.zh: 我吸气，烟从鼻孔里出来。
lines.en: I inhale, and smoke leaves through my nostrils.

lines.zh: 祭坛的灰积在我脚边，没人扫。
lines.en: Ash piles at my feet on the altar; nobody sweeps it.

lines.zh: 我在数还有谁敢靠近。
lines.en: I am counting whoever still dares come near.

lines.zh: 这地方被我烤得发白。
lines.en: This place has been baked white by me.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声像远处的雷。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like distant thunder.

lines.zh: 我不困，火不会困。
lines.en: I do not tire; fire does not tire.

lines.zh: 我在想，召唤我的人现在在哪。
lines.en: I wonder where the one who summoned me is now.

lines.zh: 安静很好，但安静有点短。
lines.en: Quiet is good, though it never lasts long.

lines.zh: 灰落在我肩上，我懒得拍。
lines.en: Ash settles on my shoulder; I do not bother brushing it off.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，火星自己往上走。
lines.en: I turn my palm over and sparks climb up on their own.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，影子被我的光拉长。
lines.en: You stand there, your shadow stretched by my light.

lines.zh: 你手里的石头，我认得那种纹路。
lines.en: I know the grain of the stone in your hand.

lines.zh: 你把我叫来这里，用的是哪块石头？
lines.en: Which stone did you use to call me here?

lines.zh: 你的盔甲在冒烟，你还没发觉。
lines.en: Your armor is smoking and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 我在看你的眼睛，看你还剩多少胆子。
lines.en: I am watching your eyes, measuring your nerve.

lines.zh: 你站得太直了，像一根等着燃的柴。
lines.en: You stand too straight, like wood waiting to burn.

lines.zh: 你居然没退，胆子比甲还厚。
lines.en: You did not back off; your nerve is thicker than your plate.

lines.zh: 你身上有祭坛的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the altar.

lines.zh: 我等的人，大概就是你。
lines.en: The one I have been waiting for is probably you.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，手在抖。
lines.en: Your hands tremble while you look at me.

lines.zh: 看够了吗？我看够了。
lines.en: Have you looked enough? I have.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我脚下，缩得很小。
lines.en: Your shadow lies at my feet, shrunk very small.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进去，火花溅到我脸上。
lines.en: Your sword bites in and sparks splash my face.

lines.zh: 我踉跄了半步，这不该发生。
lines.en: I staggered half a step, which should not happen.

lines.zh: 疼？这具身体早就烧坏了。
lines.en: Pain? This body burned out long ago.

lines.zh: 伤口边缘是红的，没有血。
lines.en: The wound's edge is red, with no blood.

lines.zh: 你居然能破开我的壳。
lines.en: You actually cracked my shell.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己也会灭。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I can be put out.

lines.zh: 我的火晃了一下，又立起来。
lines.en: My fire wavers, then stands up again.

lines.zh: 你砍的地方，正在自己愈合。
lines.en: The place you cut is healing on its own.

lines.zh: 太重的一击，我记住了你的味道。
lines.en: A heavy blow; I have your scent now.

lines.zh: 让我喘一口，火需要氧气。
lines.en: Let me breathe; fire needs air.

lines.zh: 火不稀罕食物，你手上的东西没用。
lines.en: Fire cares nothing for food; what you hold is useless.

lines.zh: 你拿玉来引我？我自己就有一块。
lines.en: You lure me with jade? I carry my own piece.

lines.zh: 这块肉烤得不错，勉强算数。
lines.en: This meat is grilled well enough; it counts.

lines.zh: 再近点，我要闻闻那东西。
lines.en: Come closer; I want to smell that thing.

lines.zh: 我不吃，但我喜欢看它烧起来。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I like watching it burn.

lines.zh: 你举着它做什么，想让我分心？
lines.en: Why hold it up, trying to distract me?

lines.zh: 热的东西我才留意，别的免谈。
lines.en: I notice only hot things; the rest can wait.

lines.zh: 你以为我会被食物哄住。
lines.en: You think food will soften me.

lines.zh: 放近一点，我看看值得不值得。
lines.en: Bring it closer; let me judge if it is worth it.

lines.zh: 这件东西，够换你一条命吗？
lines.en: Is this object worth trading for your life?

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞在烧红的墙上。
lines.en: You crash into me like hitting a red-hot wall.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你反而退了三步。
lines.en: I do not move; you retreat three steps.

lines.zh: 我的外壳很硬，你肩膀没事吧？
lines.en: My shell is hard; is your shoulder all right?

lines.zh: 碰一下，你的披风就焦了。
lines.en: One touch and your cloak is singed.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我身上的火不认人。
lines.en: Do not press so close; my fire knows no one.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，地上留下个浅坑。
lines.en: You are thrown back, leaving a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 这点冲撞，连搔痒都算轻的。
lines.en: Such a bump is barely a scratch to me.

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，给你让出半步。
lines.en: I shift aside and give you half a step.

lines.zh: 你的剑碰到我，烫得直响。
lines.en: Your sword strikes me and hisses from the heat.

lines.zh: 撞我的人，通常只有一次机会。
lines.en: Whoever rams me usually gets only one try.

lines.zh: 火不需要伴，火只需要燃料。
lines.en: Fire needs no partner, only fuel.

lines.zh: 我体内那块玉，是我唯一的伴。
lines.en: The jade inside me is my only companion.

lines.zh: 再有另一个我，这世界就烧完了。
lines.en: Another like me would burn the world out.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人走了，只剩我。
lines.en: The one who summoned me left; only I remain.

lines.zh: 两块火并在一起，只会剩下一块。
lines.en: Two fires put together leave only one.

lines.zh: 我烧得这么久，没人敢靠过来。
lines.en: I have burned so long no one dares come close.

lines.zh: 这团火，自己跟自己过。
lines.en: This flame keeps its own company.

lines.zh: 热到极处，就没有并肩这回事。
lines.en: At such heat, standing side by side is impossible.

lines.zh: 我望着自己的手，也算有个伴。
lines.en: I look at my own hands; that counts as company.

lines.zh: 灰落下来，就是我说过的话。
lines.en: The ash that falls is everything I have said.

lines.zh: 这块石头不错，能撑一会儿。
lines.en: This stone is decent; it will feed me a while.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，它在手里化了。
lines.en: I pick it up and it melts in my hand.

lines.zh: 你丢的肉，我替你烤熟了。
lines.en: I roasted the meat you dropped for you.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，我一手就拎起。
lines.en: I lift the heaviest thing with one hand.

lines.zh: 这块玉掉在地上，没人敢捡。
lines.en: This jade fell and no one dares pick it up.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，它慢慢变红。
lines.en: I hold it and it slowly turns red.

lines.zh: 我收着，反正最后都会成灰。
lines.en: I keep it; in the end everything becomes ash.

lines.zh: 捡东西这件事，我做得很少。
lines.en: Picking things up is something I rarely do.

lines.zh: 有用的留下，没用的烧掉。
lines.en: Keep what is useful, burn what is not.

lines.zh: 我把它放进火里，看看成色。
lines.en: I put it in the fire to test its quality.

lines.zh: 你踏进祭坛的范围，事情就定了。
lines.en: You stepped into the altar's reach; it is settled.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我等你来找我。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 那块召唤石的光还没散，你就是目标。
lines.en: The summoning stone still glows; you are the target.

lines.zh: 我的火认得你的影子。
lines.en: My fire knows your shadow.

lines.zh: 你动了，我也动了。
lines.en: You moved, so I moved.

lines.zh: 这地方只容一个活人，我算过了。
lines.en: Only one living soul fits here; I counted.

lines.zh: 你身上没有祭品，那就用你自己。
lines.en: You brought no offering, so you will do.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的汗，目标确认。
lines.en: I smell your sweat; target confirmed.

lines.zh: 跑吧，这样我还有点兴致。
lines.en: Run; that way I stay interested.

lines.zh: 从你踩上石阶那刻起，就这样了。
lines.en: It has been decided since you climbed the steps.

lines.zh: 你选了这条路，我选了你这人。
lines.en: You chose this path; I chose you.

lines.zh: 火已经指过去了，我不改主意。
lines.en: The fire has pointed; I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 你要的是战利品，我要的是对手。
lines.en: You want loot; I want a worthy opponent.

lines.zh: 我就在你身后，别做无用的事。
lines.en: I am behind you now; spare yourself the useless effort.

lines.zh: 你带的水不够，我知道。
lines.en: You did not bring enough water. I know.

lines.zh: 这条石阶只通向一处，就是我。
lines.en: These stone steps lead to one place only: me.

lines.zh: 你选了这个时候来，很好。
lines.en: You picked this hour to come. Good.

lines.zh: 我的火已经记住你的味道。
lines.en: My fire has already learned your smell.

lines.zh: 祭坛的符文朝你亮，你看见了吗。
lines.en: The altar runes are glowing at you. Do you see it?

lines.zh: 别找退路，这里只有一条。
lines.en: Do not look for a way back. There is only one.

lines.zh: 我在等你抬手，那一瞬最快。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to rise; that is the quickest moment.

lines.zh: 你左脚的重心不稳，我知道。
lines.en: Your weight sits wrong on the left foot; I know.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，两步半。
lines.en: I am measuring the distance: two and a half steps.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住你，差不多够了。
lines.en: My shadow covers you; that is nearly enough.

lines.zh: 你退到石柱边，那里没路。
lines.en: You back to the pillar; there is no road there.

lines.zh: 我不急，火会替我数拍子。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the fire keeps my tempo.

lines.zh: 你换手拿剑了，我看见。
lines.en: You switched sword hands; I saw.

lines.zh: 热浪先到，我随后就到。
lines.en: The heat wave arrives first; I follow.

lines.zh: 你脚下的石板在变软。
lines.en: The flagstone under you is softening.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，别误会。
lines.en: I am staring at your throat; do not misunderstand.

lines.zh: 你开始喘了，我还没开始。
lines.en: You are panting; I have not begun.

lines.zh: 这一圈火，已经封好退路。
lines.en: This ring of fire has sealed your retreat.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在远处，他救不了你。
lines.en: Your friend is far off and cannot save you.

lines.zh: 我只要一击的机会，你给了。
lines.en: I need one clean opening; you have given it.

lines.zh: 你在数我的步子，我数你的。
lines.en: You are counting my steps; I am counting yours.

lines.zh: 我的手举起来了，别眨眼。
lines.en: My hand is up. Do not blink.

lines.zh: 你在找我的破绽，我没留。
lines.en: You are hunting my weak spot. I left none.

lines.zh: 石板下是我的热气，站久会烫。
lines.en: My heat is under the flagstones. Stand long and it burns.

lines.zh: 你再退一步，就碰到墙了。
lines.en: One more step back and you hit the wall.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚下，越来越烫。
lines.en: My shadow is at your feet and getting hotter.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下去，地面陷了一块。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 这一击带着火，你的盾挡不住热。
lines.en: This blow carries fire; your shield cannot stop heat.

lines.zh: 你被扫出去，撞断了祭坛的柱子。
lines.en: You are swept away and snap an altar pillar.

lines.zh: 别退，我下一拳已经在路上。
lines.en: Do not retreat; my next punch is already coming.

lines.zh: 我打中的地方，甲片会一直烫。
lines.en: Where I land, the plate stays hot.

lines.zh: 一拳，换你半身麻木。
lines.en: One punch buys you half a body of numbness.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，空气都退开了。
lines.en: When I raise my arm, the air pulls back.

lines.zh: 你不喊，倒是有点骨气。
lines.en: You do not cry out; that is some spine.

lines.zh: 我的火顺着你的剑往上爬。
lines.en: My fire climbs up along your sword.

lines.zh: 这一下没打死你，说明你不错。
lines.en: That did not kill you, which means you are decent.

lines.zh: 我砸在你脚边，碎石飞了一地。
lines.en: I smash beside your feet and rubble sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 你挡了，手腕应该已经断了。
lines.en: You blocked it; your wrist should be broken now.

lines.zh: 下一次我不留手，也别指望我留。
lines.en: Next time I hold nothing back, so do not hope.

lines.zh: 火从我的指缝喷出，接住它。
lines.en: Fire bursts from my fingers; catch it.

lines.zh: 石头在祭坛上裂开，我从缝里出来。
lines.en: The stone splits on the altar and I come out of the crack.

lines.zh: 念完那句咒，我就站起来了。
lines.en: The moment the words end, I stand up.

lines.zh: 祭坛的符文亮了，接下来是我。
lines.en: The altar runes light up; next comes me.

lines.zh: 你知道自己在叫什么吗？
lines.en: Do you know what you are calling?

lines.zh: 召唤石碎了，代价由你付。
lines.en: The summoning stone shattered; you pay the price.

lines.zh: 我从很热的地方来，那里没有门。
lines.en: I come from a very hot place with no doors.

lines.zh: 这块地方被选中，纯属随机。
lines.en: This spot was chosen; it was entirely random.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，你听见了吧。
lines.en: You heard the sound of my landing, yes?

lines.zh: 火先来，身体随后才拼好。
lines.en: Fire arrives first; the body assembles after.

lines.zh: 别急着谢我，我不是来帮忙的。
lines.en: Do not thank me yet; I am not here to help.

lines.zh: 召唤成功，说明你够大胆。
lines.en: The summon worked, which means you are bold.

lines.zh: 我站在这，祭坛开始熔了。
lines.en: I stand here and the altar starts to melt.

lines.zh: 烟气散开的时候，你已经晚了。
lines.en: When the smoke clears, you are already too late.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫醒，谁负责收场。
lines.en: Whoever wakes me is responsible for the ending.

lines.zh: 我醒的时候，四周的草已经焦了。
lines.en: When I woke, the grass all around was already scorched.

lines.zh: 有人把石头堆好，我就有了形状。
lines.en: Someone stacked the stones, so I took a shape.

lines.zh: 石板烫起来，台阶就归我了。
lines.en: The flagstones heat up, and the stairs are mine.

lines.zh: 这一带的风被我烧停了。
lines.en: The wind here stopped because I burned it still.

lines.zh: 我落地时，祭坛矮了一截。
lines.en: When I landed, the altar sank a notch.

lines.zh: 叫我出来的人，别站太近。
lines.en: Whoever called me out, do not stand too close.

lines.zh: 同类的火烧上来，我们互相吞。
lines.en: A fire like mine climbs on and we swallow each other.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，碎石嵌进背里。
lines.en: I drop from above and rubble lodges in my back.

lines.zh: 水把我围住，我只能冒汽。
lines.en: Water surrounds me and all I can do is steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸撞上来，我的火被压扁了。
lines.en: A blast hits me and my flame is flattened.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的肩，瞬间烧成灰。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and burns to ash.

lines.zh: 魔法的冷缠上来，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: Magic cold coils around me; I hate it.

lines.zh: 没有燃料，我的火就开始低。
lines.en: Without fuel, my fire begins to sink low.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，那一下比我更亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吸住，火也拉不住我。
lines.en: The void pulls me and my fire cannot hold on.
